1. Executive Architecture: Two-Tier Decoupled Paradigm

— Canonical Normalization Layer vs. Semantic AI Reasoning Layer

The Payment Exception (PeX) Resolution Platform resolves the fundamental impedance mismatch between heterogeneous, legacy banking payment formats (Fedwire FAIM, CHAPS, BACS, SEPA, SWIFT MT103) and state-of-the-art AI reasoning models. To guarantee zero hallucination, strict regulatory compliance (BCBS 239, EU AI Act, Fed SR 11-7), and high-throughput straight-through processing (STP), the platform separates data into two distinct tiers:

TIER 1: CANONICAL DATABASE Deterministic Storage

Harmonized ISO 20022 / BIAN Relational Model

  • Cross-Rail Normalization: Ingests all wire protocols and maps counterparties, amounts, clearing rails, and routing trees to standard entities.
  • Relational Integrity: Strict primary keys, foreign keys, and indexes enforce foreign entity linking and lifecycle state transitions.
  • Zero-PII Isolation (Token Vault): Sensitive account numbers and PII are tokenized with AES-256 GCM before exposure to external components.
  • Cryptographic Provenance: SHA-256 Merkle-like hash chain guarantees immutable, tamper-evident audit trails.
TIER 2: SEMANTIC AI LAYER Contextual Reasoning

Ontology Knowledge Graph & Multi-Hypothesis Reasoner

  • Multi-Hypothesis Diagnosis: Evaluates competing failure hypotheses (e.g. invalid IBAN check digit vs. corporate sweeping accounts vs. fraud).
  • Evidence Corroboration: Synthesizes external registries (Companies House, SWIFTRef, FedLine, Trade Invoices, OFAC).
  • Dynamic Policy Evaluation: Evaluates natural-language-compiled AST policy rules dynamically with 0% downtime.
  • Human-in-the-Loop Disambiguation: Enforces human decision boundaries when multi-candidate ambiguity is detected.

3. Canonical Data Dictionary & Field Specifications

Detailed schema attributes, data types, constraints, and BIAN service domain mappings

ISO 20022 Mappings
TABLE canonical_payments
BIAN Service Domain: Payment Execution (ISO 20022 pacs.008)
FIELD NAME DATA TYPE NULLABLE ISO 20022 XML PATH DESCRIPTION / CONSTRAINTS
payment_id VARCHAR(64) PK No Document/CstmrCdtTrfInitn/GrpHdr/MsgId Primary internal identifier generated upon message ingestion.
uetr VARCHAR(36) UNIQUE No .../CdtTrfTxInf/PmtId/UETR Unique End-to-End Transaction Reference (UUIDv4 format).
amount NUMERIC(18, 2) No .../CdtTrfTxInf/Amt/InstdAmt Instructed settlement monetary amount. Must be > 0.00.
currency VARCHAR(3) No .../CdtTrfTxInf/Amt/InstdAmt/@Ccy 3-letter ISO 4217 Currency Code (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP, JPY).
payment_rail VARCHAR(32) No .../SttlmInf/SttlmMtd Clearing Rail: SWIFT_CBPR, FEDWIRE, CHAPS, TARGET2, BACS.
TABLE canonical_exceptions
BIAN Service Domain: Payment Exception Management (ISO 20022 pacs.004 / camt.056)
FIELD NAME DATA TYPE NULLABLE ENUM / CONSTRAINTS DESCRIPTION
case_id VARCHAR(32) PK No Pattern: PEX-{DOM}-{IDX} Human-readable Case Reference Number (e.g. PEX-BEN-0050).
domain VARCHAR(32) No 5 BIAN Domains DATA_QUALITY, PROCESSING, COMPLIANCE, CLIENT_TREASURY, SETTLEMENT_RETURNS.
profile VARCHAR(64) No 41 BIAN Profiles Specific taxonomy profile (e.g. INVALID_IBAN, SANCTION_HIT, BENEFICIARY_NAME_MISMATCH).
lifecycle_stage VARCHAR(32) No 10 Lifecycle States INGESTED, RECOMMENDED, PENDING_APPROVAL, RETURNED_FOR_REWORK, APPROVED, SETTLED.
sla_deadline TIMESTAMP No ISO 8601 UTC RTGS Cutoff deadline timestamp after which payment suffers settlement penalty.

4. Semantic AI Reasoning Layer Architecture

Multi-Hypothesis Decision Trees, Evidence Graph Synthesis & Context Tokenization

AI Reasoner Core
1

Context Tokenization Vault

Before feeding payment records into the AI Context Builder, all account numbers, tax IDs, and sensitive names are tokenized with format-preserving tokens (`[TOK-GB-8291]`). The raw PII never leaves the secure, isolated cryptographic vault.

2

Multi-Hypothesis Ranking

The reasoner tests 2 to 4 competing hypotheses against external ground truth. If multiple eligible hypotheses exhibit high confidence without an obvious deterministic tie-breaker, the system enforces human operator disambiguation.

3

Dynamic AST Governance

Governance rules compiled in the Policy Studio are evaluated dynamically as JSON Abstract Syntax Trees. Rules can mandate dual-authorization, route exceptions to compliance desks, or auto-qualify micro-repairs for fast-lane release.

5. Lifecycle State Transition Machine

Formal state machine transitions governed by Maker-Checker Segregation of Duties (SoD)

SoD Gated 
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> INGESTED : Raw Bank Payload Ingestion
    INGESTED --> CANONICALIZED : Format Normalization & Tokenization
    CANONICALIZED --> RECOMMENDED : AI Diagnostic Synthesis (>85% Conf)
    
    RECOMMENDED --> PENDING_APPROVAL : Maker Review & Submission
    RECOMMENDED --> RETURNED_FOR_REWORK : Maker Manual Edit
    
    PENDING_APPROVAL --> APPROVED : Checker Dual-Authorization (Tier 1/2)
    PENDING_APPROVAL --> RETURNED_FOR_REWORK : Checker Rejection with Comments
    
    RETURNED_FOR_REWORK --> RECOMMENDED : Maker Re-Diagnosis
    
    APPROVED --> DISPATCHED : Settlement Rail ISO pacs.008 Dispatch
    DISPATCHED --> SETTLED : RTGS Clearing Confirmation Receipt
    SETTLED --> [*]
